24X7 Cashback Card Terms & Conditions
Your monthly income should be a minimum of AED 5,000.
What are the annual fees on the Mashreq 24X7 Cashback Credit Card?
The Mashreq 24X7 Cashback Credit Card is free for life for Primary as well as Supplementary Card(s).
Is there any minimum spend to start earning cashback?
No, there is no minimum spend requirement to earn cashback
All retails purchases made on your Card will be eligible for the cashback. Spends not qualified for cashback are:
When will the cashback be calculated and credited?
The cashback will be calculated and credited in 2-3 working days from the posting of qualifying transactions.
When and how can I check and redeem the cashback that I have earned?
Cashback can be redeemed once a minimum cashback balance of AED 100 is achieved.
The primary cardholder can redeem the cashback through the following digital channels:
Log in to Mashreq Mobile App and select your Mashreq 24x7 cashback credit card
Click on ‘Cashback Redemption’ under ‘More Options’
Enter the desired amount and your cashback will be applied directly to the outstanding balance of the cardOR
Select your Mashreq Al Islami 24x7 Cashback Credit Card
Click on Cashback redemption (top right-hand corner)
Enter the desired amount and your Cashback will be applied directly to the outstanding balance of the card
Will the cashback ever expire?
Yes, the cashback earned has a maximum validity of 36 months from the date of earning. If the cashback is not redeemed within this period, it will expire.
Additionally, accumulated cashback will be forfeited in the below cases:
You have not earned or redeemed any cashback in last twelve (12) months or the Card account is delinquent.
I have a supplementary card as well? Will I earn cashback on this card as well?

Cashback will be earned on spends made on the supplementary card(s) as well. However, please note that the cashback can be redeemed only against the Primary Card account and will appear only on the statement of the Primary Card account.

Will the cashback earned apply directly to the outstanding balance of the Credit Card? How does the minimum amount due get affected if I redeem the cashback covering the partial amount of the total outstanding?

The cashback earned can be redeemed upon your choice to the Credit Card account and will be applied directly to the outstanding balance of the card but does not count towards the minimum monthly payment on the card. The cashback is considered as a credit towards the card account and not as a payment, so you must still make the minimum monthly payment due on the card.
Which streaming subscriptions qualify for cashback?
subscriptions to eligible streaming services such as Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, and similar platforms qualify for cashback. Check terms and conditions for more details.
What is the billing cycle and due date for Mashreq 24X7 Cashback Credit Card?
The billing cycle date (statement date) for Mashreq 24X7 Cashback Credit Card is 15th of each month and the due date is 27 days from the statement/billing date.
